text:
sanjay: heads up — NA2 experiencing a sharp P95/P99 token latency spike. Provisioner queue is fragmenting hotpool allocations, KV cache miss rate jumped to ~42%, batch sizes falling to 1-2. Impacting customer p99 SLAs.

infra-bot: [ALERT] na2-hotpool: latency_p99_above_threshold (3m) :rotating_light:

kevin: seeing it too. recent logs show provisioner allocate timeouts and batcher assigning tiny batches.

kevin: ```
ERROR provisioner: allocate timeout=120s pool=na2-hotpool id=gpux-23
WARN batcher: assigned_batch_size=1 expected_batch_size>=8
WARN kvcache: miss_rate=0.42 hot_tenants=11
```

elaine: can we divert traffic to NA1 and temporarily increase hotpool size? I can push a quick hotpatch to bump alloc timeout and disable strict affinity.

ryan: prepping reroute, will shift 30% to NA1 if we agree. running: `rbctl route set-weight --region na2 --weight 70`

ryan: output: `ok — weights updated (na2=70, na1=30)` :white_check_mark:

kevin: also suggests rolling back last batcher heuristic change (commit 5a9f4c) — it reduced batch coalescing for short tails.

elaine: agreed. i'll roll back batcher and push provisioner timeout patch (alloc_timeout=240s).

infra-bot: deploy started by elaine — provisioner/alloc-timeout-hotfix (id: deploy-3401)

ryan: scaled na2-hotpool +2 gpus (temp) — `poolctl scale --pool na2-hotpool --delta 2` -> `ok`

sam: FYI cost hit estimate ~+$6k/day while extra GPUs + cross-region traffic. are we ok with that for 2 hours? :thinking_face:

sanjay: yes, prioritize latency. keep for up to 2 hours and we'll revert if stable.

elaine: provisioner patch rolled out, rollback of batcher commit queued and applied. also enabled kv prefetch for top tenants.

infra-bot: deploy finished — provisioner-hotfix (deploy-3401) status=success

kevin: preliminary metrics: p99 down from 1.8s -> 220ms, kv miss down 42% -> 12%, avg batch size back to 7.

sanjay: great work. keep monitoring for 30m and then start returning traffic slowly if stable. I'll create a short post-incident note with timeline. :thumbsup:

ryan: will monitor dashboards and post graphs in ~10m.

sam: logging cost delta to incident ticket.

elaine: filing a retro and proposed change: add canary for batching heuristics + safeguard to prevent allocation fragmentation.

sanjay: thanks everyone — follow-up tasks in #incidents.
